prompt: Create ONE original production game environment asset: a COMPLETE BROAD LOW LIMESTONE BANK SHOULDER, isolated on true transparent background. This is a 2D side-view hand-painted gouache fairy-tale game, NOT a concept landscape or game screenshot. Reference 1 and 2 establish the approved material ONLY: warm ivory limestone planes, cool lavender-grey shadows, restrained yellow-green moss, visible soft brushwork, gentle upper-left daylight. Reference 3 shows the ACTUAL game scale/use and must NOT be reproduced. Its tall distant masonry and rectangular near banks are precisely the mismatch to avoid. Draw a WIDE LOW natural bedrock shoulder, three or four large sloping fractured masses fused into one continuous rock body, broad landward body on LEFT and a short steep inward-facing bank end on RIGHT. It is about 3.2 times wider than tall, NOT a vertical pillar, boulder pile, tower, bridge arch, stairs or rectangular tile. Designed visible size about 620 world units wide and 190 high; game zoom 1.6. Target 1536x1024 transparent canvas with the broad asset occupying roughly x48..1488 and y380..900; retain the ENTIRE natural contour and every root. The upper attachment band is modest subdued moss, not a bright flat walkable grass ledge; no projecting horizontal shelf, steps or repeated horizontal treads. Large diagonal rock planes and a dark inward-facing cleft communicate depth. The right channel edge slopes down steeply without sticking into the channel; the broad left base slopes down landward. A few fine roots originate visibly in moss seams, no giant flowers. Main body is solid opaque painted rock with NO accidental transparent vertical slit. Natural alpha outline may be irregular; do NOT force a rectangular silhouette. All outside is fully transparent, no ground plane, cast-shadow floor, haze, glow, sky, background, checkerboard, text, border or other objects. Do not include the player, UI, chest, bell, waterworks wall or distant hills. Keep detail much quieter than the game's brass pickups. This is a single intact source asset for later real engine integration, not an atlas.
